skillTalents.name: Allegoria
skillTalents.description: Normal Attack Proclaims a decree in the primordial tongue and performs up to 3 attacks that deal Pyro DMG . Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Pyro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time. Plunging Attack Nicole plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Also deals AoE Pyro DMG upon impact with the ground.

skillTalents.name: Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent
skillTalents.description: As Nicole weaves the path of anchored fate with golden threads of light, she deals AoE Pyro DMG and switches to Silent Contemplation mode. In this mode, when nearby active party members hit an opponent, an Arcane Projection is summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG scales based on the corresponding character's ATK and will be considered as having been dealt by them. This effect can occur once every 3s, and can be triggered up to 4 times each time Nicole switches to Silent Contemplation mode. It is worth noting that Hexerei characters' Arcane Projections appear to differ somehow in appearance from the others...

passiveTalents.name: Light in the Darkness
passiveTalents.description: After completing Witch's Homework : The Role of a Guide...? , Nicole becomes a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters. Hexerei: Secret Rite Increases the DMG dealt by Hexerei characters' Arcane Projections by 300% of Nicole's ATK .

passiveTalents.name: Nepsis
passiveTalents.description: When you are in Teyvat and not in combat, Nicole's Charged Attack becomes "Emissarial Guidance" if you have already obtained the current region 's Treasure Compass . Emissarial Guidance: Calls upon nearby Seelie to show the way, triggering an effect similar to the region's Treasure Compass. This effect has a cooldown time of 5 seconds and does not work in Domains , Trounce Domains , and the Spiral Abyss .

constellations.name: "Do Not Be Afraid, Child Who Is Loved"
constellations.description: When the current active character of your own in the party hits an opponent, an additional special "Arcane Projection: Unity" will be summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type at 600% of their ATK . This DMG will be considered as having been dealt by the corresponding character. This effect can trigger once every 6s.
